W.note: A quiet lavender halo blooms and fades on sensible curves with a clear white pill label and a focus reveal, though it reads less dreamlike than Y or Z.

X.note: The violet-to-teal-to-pink aurora shift is the most vivid hover, but the phone layout overflows and clips the card and lede at the right edge, the gradient animates background-position (repaints), and focus has no lift or glow reveal.

Y.note: Clean on desktop and phone, with an asymmetric enter (360 ms) and leave (180 ms), a small-overshoot float preset, a violet-mint halo, and keyboard focus that mirrors hover.

Z.note: The most atmospheric result, with a sheen and halo ring on a dark product card, but a 700 ms enter and leave is slow for a real button and the reduced-motion path still jumps the sheen.
